However many trans travellers have updated documents. Still, the regime treats sex as birth sex; a trans woman with F passport and F presentation may be fine unless questioned. Also the national "case-note tag" — the same text in all cases refused or pending advisory opinion. That suggests visa applications from trans people may be tagged.
